claim: What are the foundational habits that carry you forward? Can you instantly point to the things you do as part of every day?

If you can't instantly point to the things you do as part of every day, that's a problem, because it adds up over time: without those fundamentals in place every day, we go nowhere, or certainly not where we want to go
Your personal foundation is the habits you implement every day in the five pillars of power: fitness, nutrition, hormone optimization, sex energy optimization and mind

The five pillars of power are pillars because without any one of them the foundation will crumble over time: do everything else right but neglect your mind, for example, and it all comes down. We need all five
Some examples of a personal foundation, not a prescription of this and this every day, but foundational things that really support you
As an example of a personal foundation, not a prescription: water is so huge
name: Water and hydration

claim: For the guys going through Bootcamp right now, water was one of the very first topics, on day one
name: Water and hydration

claim: Dehydrated, your energy, decision making and workouts suffer: a trickle-down effect

claim: As an example of a personal foundation, not a prescription: physical grinding every day
The Bootcamp guys do push-ups and squats every single day

section: Remind yourself you can do hard things
claim: We need strong bodies and minds, and to remind ourselves daily that we can do hard things
A suggestion: no matter what else you do, do push-ups and squats
Doing push-ups and squats sounds so simple, but make it part of your foundation and things change
As an example of a personal foundation, not a prescription: rest days occasionally, yes, but grind every day
Not a little bit sore from day to day means not pushing hard enough; super sore maybe means you pushed a little too hard or didn't recover enough
Without the physical work, the physical part of the foundation is weak, and if it's not causing problems yet, it will
We cannot build the life we want without a complete foundation
As an example of a personal foundation, not a prescription, meditating: if we don't take care of our mind, whatever else we do, it all crumbles
Meditation is one of the best ways to take care of, understand and connect with our mind, connect with others, de-stress, on and on
If meditating is not part of your foundation, make it part: it will truly benefit your life
As an example of a personal foundation, not a prescription, Kegels, every day: we need to exercise our sexual core just like the rest of our body
Without exercising our sexual core every day, the effects kind of add up and the foundation of your sex life kind of falls apart
The foundation of your sex life is not just dependent on Kegels, but we need the physical strength of the sexual core
As an example of a personal foundation, not a prescription: building your sexual energy, which you can build day by day
The habits around building your sexual energy are hugely impactful
Without semen retention in your foundation, you're leaving a lot on the table
"I truly believe" you will not be able to experience, achieve or be what you want while giving up your sexual energy: "it doesn't work"
Conserve and build your sexual energy instead of wasting it

section: Remind yourself you can do hard things
claim: Maybe one of the last examples of a personal foundation, "I think", not a prescription: do hard things
Achieving what you haven't yet, new things, growing: life is hard, not about easy

section: Remind yourself you can do hard things
claim: We need to remind ourselves every day that we can do hard things and come back to that deeper, stronger place
Physical grinding is a great way to remind ourselves every day that we can do hard things, but one habit is so beneficial for it, one the Bootcamp guys do too: cold showers
A cold shower is choosing the uncomfortable thing in the moment because you know it leads where you want to go
On the physical and mental benefits of cold showers, "the science is there", and anybody who's tried them will tell you they're so worth it

The brief discomfort is the best part of a cold shower, and seemingly why cold showers should be part of your foundation: every day they remind you that you can do hard things, to look discomfort in the face and choose it
Going where you want means feeling discomfort, maybe not a cold shower's, so practice feeling it, get used to it, and make it your friend, because discomfort is your friend

Foundational habits such as water, daily grinding, meditating, Kegels, semen retention and cold showers seem so powerful and are encouraged here, but whether or not you agree with them, suggested: step back today and think about what foundational things carry you
Foundations are not complex: simple, right things, done every day
Done every day is the only way simple, right things provide a foundation to grow from: done once a month, they are worthless
If you don't know what foundational things carry you, decide: these are the things, starting today. Or look back at what you have and haven't been doing
We know when we're off the path: putting a foundation in place is such a powerful shift, and you'll go where you want and feel better
If parts of your foundation are missing, put those habits in place, across your physical and mental space
The discipline to do a few simple foundational things every day makes you feel better the whole rest of the day
